thread:
Marta Chen: Need to finalize an adjunct offer for Kai (DE). Wants local pay. Band lookup shows S3 but adjunct cap usually S2. Proposing USD 105k annualized pro-rated for 6 months + $3k sign-on and split onboarding (2w remote then onsite).
Sam Patel: @Marta geo differential >10% vs cap requires finance sign-off. Adjunct exceptions allowed with market rationale. Can you paste a one-liner rationale and confirm exact start dates?
Marta Chen: Rationale: niche infra+serving skills, immediate impact on latency/unit-cost; low chance of conversion in 6mo. Start remote 2026-04-20, onsite 2026-05-04. Added note in offer doc.
Priya Nair: Heads up on payroll: if engaged in DE via EoR we must show gross EUR equivalent. Who will handle payroll? Also adjuncts are not benefits-eligible until conversion 12; note in letter.
Lars Becker: Need cost_center and budget_owner. Any PO? Exceptions above band cap need director sign-off. Ping @offers-bot so we have a ticket.
Marta Chen: cost_center: ENG-ML-101, budget_owner: Marta Chen, PO: n/a (contractor). No planned conversion. Routing to finance + legal ok.
offers-bot: Approval request created: APP-8921. Routing: people-ops -> finance -> legal. https://redwood.in/offers/APP-8921
Sam Patel: Please paste market-premium line into APP-8921 (helps approvals).
Marta Chen: Pasted: "Specialist MLOps/serving expertise; immediate production impact on latency and unit cost; market comp ~12% above S2 cap; 6mo fixed-term."
offers-bot: APP-8921 routed to Finance at 1799995035.
Lars Becker: Provisional approval: USD 52,500 for 6 months + $3,000 sign-on. Approve pending contractor tax classification from People Ops. :thumbsup:
Priya Nair: Legal flagged contractor/employee risk. Recommend addendum: "If conversion occurs within 3 months, benefits and tax treatment will be reviewed and adjustments applied." Objections?
Marta Chen: No objections, add clause.
Sam Patel: I'll add the addendum, update APP-8921, and prepare offer letter. ETA today EOD if legal signs off. People Ops will send the offer centrally once payroll confirms gross EUR equivalent.
offers-bot: APP-8921 closed: Offer cleared to send at 1799995068.
